first.rationale: I currently intend to test onboarding simplification because completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence suggests shorter onboarding and fewer signup fields can improve early adoption. I want to verify the two most directly relevant records before committing. The test should be guarded because higher completion or activation may not translate into qualified long-term revenue; downstream quality and retention must be monitored.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification experiment this week, prioritizing the signup and onboarding friction associated with the current completion and activation declines. The shortened-flow evidence shows improved completion, faster time-to-value, and higher 30-day retention. The SMB signup evidence supports activation and qualified-revenue gains, but its slight retention decline and limited segment applicability require monitoring. Evaluate not only completion and activation, but also qualified revenue, 30-day retention, and account quality before expanding.
